event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approximately 5.8 nm off Pulau Tondang (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane Singapore Strait. Indonesia

sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2023
sources.text: While underway, the master reported to Singapore VTIS that three perpetrators were spotted by the ship’s crew in the engine room. The perpetrators were armed with knives. The master sounded the alarm and mustered the crew. At about 0403 hrs, the master reported that the three intruders escaped in a small boat at the astern of her ship. All crew members were safe and accounted for, and nothing was stolen. The master informed that no further assistance is required.
